page.layout: One page of running text, with a running head at the top; below the text, a short verse of three couplets-like lines and a signature in the body; no margin notes; no catchword or signature mark.

main_text.p: debita profequor obseruantia, idq; vestras illas ob virtutes eximias, diuinitus & liberaliter vobis concessas, prudentiam puto, agendi dexte ritatem, eruditionem, eloquentiam iustitiamq; & quòd inter hæc excellit, veræ & synceræ religionis amore eiusq; propagandæ studium singulare. In quibus vt pergatis quàm possum maximè hortor, Dominum interim Deum nostrum obsecrans, vt dona ista sua in vobis & confirmet & augeat ad sui nominis gloriam totiusq; Reipub. nostræ salutem & incolumitatem. Bene valete. Dominus & vobis & familijs vestris benedicere dignetur, & ab omni præseruare malo. Datæ Bernæ in Helvetia 5. Maij. Anno salutis nostræ M. D. LXXII.
main_text.l: Tu, qui Romulea Præsul in vrbe sedes.
At quia cœlestis tibi verbi oracula sordent,
I, morere, en proprio cæsus ab ense iaces.

page.notes: The verse lines are set in italic type in the scan; the first line is italic and the following lines appear in roman. Faint show-through from the reverse page (lines at lower right and a small "De" mark at lower left) is omitted. Possible doubtful readings: "Verbo" and "sordent" are clear; "Helvetia" is read from "Heluetia", spelled as printed in the scan: "Helvetia" was printed as "Heluetia" and is copied as printed.
